nbc986b9f12.headline: Oil prices drop after US, Iran pause fighting over weekend
nbc986b9f12.summary: Oil prices tumbled more than 5% on Monday after the US and Iran paused fighting, though Strait of Hormuz traffic stayed low. Red Sea shipping slowed after a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia.
nbc986b9f12.why: Crude oil is a globally traded benchmark commodity, and the Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil supply, so Gulf conflict feeds directly into energy prices.
nbc986b9f12.why_moved: A pause in US-Iran fighting reduces fears of supply disruption in the Gulf, and the report states oil fell more than 5% on the news.

n8174ced319.headline: Russia Demands Europe Pay for Ukraine War Damages, Return Frozen Assets
n8174ced319.summary: Moscow will demand compensation from Europe for war damages in Ukraine and seek the return of $300 billion in frozen Russian assets.
n8174ced319.why: Russian central bank assets frozen in Western jurisdictions are a major issue for European banks, sanctions policy and cross-border capital flows.

na6c71573cb.headline: Oil prices sink, shares gain as US, Iran pause fighting
na6c71573cb.summary: Global shares were mostly higher on Monday and oil prices slipped nearly 7% after the U.S. and Iran paused strikes over the weekend following two weeks of fighting.
na6c71573cb.why: Crude oil is the world's most traded commodity, and its price feeds into inflation, corporate costs and energy-sector earnings. Escalation or easing in the Middle East is a major driver of its price.
na6c71573cb.why_moved: The pause in US-Iran strikes reduced the risk of supply disruption in the region, and oil prices fell sharply in response. Equity markets rose on the easing of geopolitical tension.

n8c289aa604.headline: AECOM selected to design New Lisbon Airport
n8c289aa604.summary: AECOM has been chosen to deliver the preliminary design for Portugal's new national airport, according to a company announcement. The contract was reported as part of the project.
n8c289aa604.why: AECOM is a US-listed infrastructure consulting and engineering firm that designs and manages large public works projects worldwide.

n2626090a2f.headline: Oil prices ease after US and Iran pause their attacks
n2626090a2f.summary: Oil prices fell further in early trading after reaching a two-month high last week. The easing follows a pause in attacks between the US and Iran.
n2626090a2f.why: Crude oil prices are the main global energy benchmark and move with supply risk in producing regions such as the Middle East.
n2626090a2f.why_moved: A pause in attacks between the US and Iran reduced fears of supply disruption, after oil had reached a two-month high.

n1604b7014c.headline: Oil Prices Tumble 7%, Global Markets Rally As China
n1604b7014c.summary: Oil fell nearly 7% and global markets rallied on Monday. Investors welcomed signs that the US and Iran stepped back from confrontation and discussed resuming talks on an interim ceasefire.
n1604b7014c.why: Brent crude is the main global benchmark for oil, and Middle East supply risks strongly affect its price. Shifts in US-Iran tensions are a key driver of energy prices and inflation expectations.
n1604b7014c.why_moved: Investors welcomed signs that the US and Iran had stepped back from further military confrontation and were discussing a possible resumption of negotiations on an interim ceasefire deal.

na41d2096f6.headline: #economy: Meridian's New Solar Farm Cleared as Renewable Energy Push Accelerates
na41d2096f6.summary: Meridian Energy has received resource consent to develop a 110-megawatt solar farm near Morrinsville. The project is part of New Zealand's shift toward renewable electricity and energy security.
na41d2096f6.why: Meridian Energy is a major New Zealand electricity generator, largely hydro and wind, and is listed on the NZX. Its project pipeline shapes the country's renewable power supply.

na64041950a.headline: Venice raises more than $A8m from tourist charge
na64041950a.summary: More than 650,000 tourists paid the day-trip fee to visit Venice from April, raising more than A$8 million. The charge is levied on visitors arriving as day trippers.
na64041950a.why: Venice's day-trip access fee is a municipal levy on tourism, a major local income source for the city. Such charges are watched by investors in tourism and hospitality as a signal of visitor-management policy.

n20cbb5e58c.headline: Former ANZ CEO Abandons Court Fight Over Unpaid Bonus as Board Holds the Line
n20cbb5e58c.summary: Former ANZ chief executive Shayne Elliott has dropped his legal case against the bank over an alleged A$13.5 million unpaid bonus. The board held its position.
n20cbb5e58c.why: ANZ Group is one of Australia's four major banks, so executive pay and governance disputes draw investor attention.

n97f2fa051c.headline: Fresh Supply Of Retail Space In Malls Down 57% In Jan-Mar Across Top 7 Cities: Anarock
n97f2fa051c.summary: Fresh supply of retail space in shopping malls across India's top seven cities fell 57% in January to March, according to Anarock. The report covers mall supply only.
n97f2fa051c.why: Anarock is an Indian real estate consultancy, and mall supply trends indicate developer activity and retail property demand.

n74dfdc0227.headline: #climatechange: Climate Lawsuit Ban Could Put NZ-EU Trade Deal at Risk, Legal Expert Warns
n74dfdc0227.summary: A legal scholar warns that a government proposal to prevent climate lawsuits against major emitters could affect the New Zealand-EU trade deal. The effects could extend beyond domestic courts.
n74dfdc0227.why: Trade agreements depend on shared standards, and investor perceptions of regulatory risk can influence access to markets. The proposal links domestic climate litigation to international trade.

n4f064a8f81.headline: China chipmaker CXMT shoots skyward in blockbuster Shanghai listing
n4f064a8f81.summary: Shares of CXMT, China's largest memory chipmaker, surged on their first day of trading in Shanghai, marking mainland China's biggest initial public offering.
n4f064a8f81.why: Memory chips such as DRAM are a core component of computing, and a large listing signals capital flowing into China's domestic semiconductor sector.

n49a9b92bf8.headline: Why ConocoPhillips Stock Got Mashed on Monday
n49a9b92bf8.summary: ConocoPhillips shares fell on Monday after oil prices eased over the weekend with a lull in the US-Iran war.
n49a9b92bf8.why: ConocoPhillips is a major US independent oil and gas producer, so its share price tracks crude prices closely.

impacts.name: ConocoPhillips
impacts.why: Share price fell as oil prices eased, reducing expected upstream revenue.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n49a9b92bf8.why_moved: Oil prices eased over the weekend as the US-Iran war paused, which weighed on oil producer shares.

n584f01094c.headline: Is Brent Oil's Gap Lower a Bull Trap in Disguise?
n584f01094c.summary: Brent oil gapped sharply lower to $85.50 as US-Iran strikes paused. Shipping data shows little real improvement so far, raising doubts about the move's durability.
n584f01094c.why: Brent is the main international crude benchmark, and its price is driven by Middle East supply risk, shipping flows and demand expectations.
n584f01094c.why_moved: Brent gapped lower as US-Iran strikes paused, though the report notes shipping data has not yet shown a real improvement.

n4b4f5c854a.headline: Anthropic Ordered to Pay $1.5 Billion in Largest AI Copyright Settlement
n4b4f5c854a.summary: A US court approved Anthropic's $1.5 billion settlement over pirated books used to train its Claude AI model. The settlement is described as the largest AI copyright settlement.
n4b4f5c854a.why: Anthropic is a private artificial-intelligence company that develops the Claude models, so copyright liabilities affect its costs and the wider AI industry's data practices.

na7559b54ab.headline: Bank of Baroda Faces Alleged 1TB Data Leak, Probe Underway As Sensitive Customer Information Reportedly Appears Online
na7559b54ab.summary: Bank of Baroda is investigating claims of a 1TB data leak in which sensitive customer and internal banking records were allegedly made available on the dark web.
na7559b54ab.why: Bank of Baroda is one of India's largest state-owned lenders, so data breaches can bring regulatory scrutiny, remediation costs and reputational damage.

n51ee3a0bc9.headline: Oil prices plunge as US and Iran pause strikes over Strait of Hormuz
n51ee3a0bc9.summary: Oil prices eased in early trading on Monday, falling further from a two-month high set last week. The United States and Iran refrained from launching military strikes in the Persian Gulf.
n51ee3a0bc9.why: Brent and WTI are the main global crude benchmarks, and the Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so Gulf tensions feed directly into energy prices.
n51ee3a0bc9.why_moved: The United States and Iran paused military strikes in the Persian Gulf, easing fears of supply disruption through the Strait of Hormuz. Prices were falling from a two-month high set the previous week.

n79466acea0.headline: Chinese RAM Chip Giant CXMT Raises $8.5 Billion in Record IPO
n79466acea0.summary: Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT raised $8.5 billion in a record IPO. Its shares jumped nearly 470% after the Shanghai listing, making it mainland China's most valuable listed company by market value.
n79466acea0.why: CXMT is a major Chinese maker of DRAM memory chips, a key input for computing and smartphones.

sources.name: Techweez | Tech News, Reviews, Deals, Tips and How To

n79466acea0.why_moved: A record $8.5 billion listing and a near-470% first-day gain have drawn investor attention to China's semiconductor sector.

n9745938e4e.headline: Dubai gold buyers face Dh5 per gram increase after weekend pause in fighting
n9745938e4e.summary: Dubai gold prices climbed again and are nearing July highs but remain below the Dh500 peak. Buyers face a Dh5 per gram increase after a weekend pause in fighting.
n9745938e4e.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset, and its price tends to rise during geopolitical tension and uncertainty.

n212af4f73f.headline: Oil Prices Just Posted Their Biggest One-Day Drop in Two Months. Here
n212af4f73f.summary: Oil prices plunged after the United States and Iran suddenly halted fighting that had resumed in recent weeks, producing the sharpest one-day decline in two months.
n212af4f73f.why: Crude is the benchmark energy commodity, and changes in Middle East conflict risk feed directly into fuel costs, inflation expectations and energy equities.
n212af4f73f.why_moved: The US and Iran suddenly halted fighting that had resumed in recent weeks, removing a major source of supply-risk premium from crude.

n915cab787c.headline: Pacquiao, billionaire Razon join hands to tackle brownouts
n915cab787c.summary: Ignite Power, a venture backed by Manny Pacquiao and billionaire Razon, has won key backing to modernise the power distribution network. The project aims to address brownouts.
n915cab787c.why: Power distribution networks determine electricity reliability for households and industry in the Philippines. Private investment in grid modernisation is a growing theme in emerging markets.

n66bfe3aef2.headline: Why Sandisk Stock Crashed on Monday
n66bfe3aef2.summary: Sandisk stock crashed on Monday as China took aim at memory-stock profits, with the company described as a possible next target.
n66bfe3aef2.why: Sandisk is a US maker of flash memory and storage products, and its results depend heavily on the NAND memory market and Chinese demand.
n66bfe3aef2.why_moved: China's move to target memory-stock profits, with Sandisk named as a possible next target, drove the sharp decline.

n26c04e2684.headline: Bill shock: Marcos wants systems loss charge, VAT scrapped
n26c04e2684.summary: President Marcos wants power utilities to remove systems loss charges passed on to consumers, along with the value-added tax on that fee, amid complaints over electricity bill shock.
n26c04e2684.why: Electricity tariffs and their pass-through charges affect household budgets, inflation and the profitability of power distributors.

nba61e38b23.headline: PSEi returns to 6,300 level as Mideast tensions ease
nba61e38b23.summary: The PSEi returned to the 6,300 level as declining oil prices lifted investor sentiment. The input links the easing to reduced Mideast tensions.
nba61e38b23.why: The PSEi is the Philippine Stock Exchange's main index, and the Philippines is a large oil importer, so oil prices affect local sentiment.
nba61e38b23.why_moved: Declining oil prices as Mideast tensions eased lifted investor sentiment and pushed the index back to 6,300.

nc1edd8eec3.headline: Okayed trials for polymer notes for  ₹10, 20; no plan to replace paper yet: Govt
nc1edd8eec3.summary: The RBI proposed printing 1 billion each of ₹10 and ₹20 polymer banknotes for field trials. The government said there is no plan yet to replace paper notes.
nc1edd8eec3.why: The Reserve Bank of India issues the country's currency and manages its cash and payments system.

na202e8b5ae.headline: PAGCOR decoupling to cost health care up to P2.1 billion yearly
na202e8b5ae.summary: Privatising Casino Filipino, run by PAGCOR, may remove P1.7 billion to P2.1 billion a year from Universal Health Care funding, according to Geronimo Law. The estimate is from a local law firm.
na202e8b5ae.why: PAGCOR is the Philippine state gaming regulator and operator, and its revenue has funded public health programs.

n8e6cf7a78b.headline: Sara loses majority support
n8e6cf7a78b.summary: Trump described talks with Iran as very friendly during a lull in strikes. Netanyahu praised the talks, which focus on keeping Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons.
n8e6cf7a78b.why: Developments in Middle East conflict affect oil supply risk, shipping routes and the wider regional risk premium in markets.

n3cb3739d60.headline: Ex-DOF chiefs to Marcos: Keep 2027 budget clean
n3cb3739d60.summary: Former finance chiefs urged President Marcos to keep the 2027 national budget clean and transparent, free of congressional insertions, and to use his veto power more.
n3cb3739d60.why: The national budget sets government spending and deficit targets, which influence bond yields, fiscal credibility and the outlook for the Philippine economy.
